transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1758 Echo Canyon Drive?
Yes, this is me. My father needs help—he’s in a manual wheelchair and can’t leave alone.
Thank you for sharing this information. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people here. Dad’s in a manual wheelchair, can’t leave alone.

Got it, two people here, Dad needs wheelchair. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Yes, Dad can’t leave alone—he uses a manual wheelchair. It’s not motorized.
Got it, Dad uses a manual wheelchair and can’t leave alone. Who is it that can't leave on their own, and what do they need to get out?
It’s my father—he needs his manual wheelchair to get out.
I heard you need his wheelchair to get out. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Dad’s in the wheelchair, can’t leave him alone.
I hear you’re caring for your dad right now. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. Dad’s in a manual wheelchair, can’t leave him alone.

I hear you’re caring for your dad in a manual wheelchair. Let me read that back: 2 people; Dad needs help leaving because of manual wheelchair; father needs help leaving because of his manual wheelchair; dad needs help leaving because of wheelchair; dad needs help leaving because of manual wheelchair; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Two people. Dad’s in a manual wheelchair. Can’t leave alone. No water in yet.

Got it. Dad’s in manual wheelchair. No water in yet. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Two people. Dad needs manual wheelchair to leave. No water inside. English language.
